fact: On 18 March 2025 Mali's ministers presented the land information system / one-stop land office (SIF/GUF) to the Prime Minister's steering committee, to be operational in the six communes of Bamako and meant to computerise land allocation and management and improve revenue recovery.
title: DIGITALISATION DE L’ADMINISTRATION : Deux nouvelles plateformes de modernisation lancées
publisher: ORTM - Office de Radio et Television du Mali
